messages.author: 8d49511197992b29
messages.subject: Updating to 1.9.2
parts:
Does anyone know why RStudio (Windows 64 bit) might refuse to update GGIR to 1.9.2? RStudio gives me the option of update GGIR to 1.9.2, but when I run through the process, it reloads to version 1.9.1? After restarting RStudio I still have the option of updating, because it is still running 1.9.1. Perhaps more of an R question than a GGIR question, but does anyone have any thoughts?

Many thanks and warm regards, 

Scott

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Updating to 1.9.2
parts:
This is because the Windows version of GGIR has not been updated to 1.9-2 yet, see: https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=GGIR 
Usually it takes a couple of days before a new version is available on all operating systems. CRAN has separate processes for Linux, OSx, and Windows
Vincent
